ability.kerneldef.name: Kernel Defense
kerneldef.title: Kernel Defense
kerneldef.hint: Pick a program → click a pad to deploy · Click an enemy = SIGKILL · O overclock · P pause
kerneldef.menu.tagline: Hold the CPU core against wave after wave
kerneldef.menu.help:
Pick a program → click a pad to deploy
Click an enemy = SIGKILL (6s cooldown) · O = overclock
Watch the temperature and power, don't cook the core
kerneldef.over.title: CORE BREACHED
kerneldef.pause.title: Paused
kerneldef.pause.hint: Press P / Esc or click to resume
kerneldef.selectedHint: Click a deployed program to upgrade / salvage
kerneldef.tower.scanner.name: Scanner
kerneldef.tower.scanner.desc: Cheap, fast single-target turret — good against worms and viruses.
kerneldef.tower.firewall.name: Firewall
kerneldef.tower.firewall.desc: Splash damage and a slow field — great at bus corners.
kerneldef.tower.antivirus.name: Antivirus
kerneldef.tower.antivirus.desc: Long range, high damage, ignores armor. Handles trojans and bosses, but power-hungry.
kerneldef.tower.honeypot.name: Honeypot
kerneldef.tower.honeypot.desc: Deals no damage; generates compute over time. The earlier the better.
kerneldef.msg.welcome: Deploy your defense programs onto the pads to stop the intrusion
kerneldef.msg.pickTower: Pick a defense program below first
kerneldef.msg.noPower: Not enough power — upgrade the supply first
kerneldef.msg.ocOn: Overclock! All programs sped up — watch the heat
kerneldef.reset.title: Clear game data?
kerneldef.reset.body: This erases the best wave, kill and score records. It cannot be undone.
